title: Published catalog
description: stories/<channel>/catalog.json on the content host (draft or production): the shelf the app downloads at every launch, written by `story package` from content/catalog.json, the stories and content/app/narration.json. The app ignores fields it doesn't know. See docs/story-format.md, "Published stories".

narration.description: The lines the narrator says at the end of every story (content/app/narration.json), recorded once per language: language -> clip id -> its file in app/. The app plays the-end as "The End" rises on the ending screen, then more-endings while the story has endings left to find, or all-endings once every one is found. A language is listed once it has a clip (on production, all three); the key is missing when no language has one.

file.description: A file named after its contents, in the story's folder (stories/<channel>/<id>/) or, for the catalog's narration, in app/ (stories/<channel>/app/).

endings.description: How many endings the story has, shown on its cover before it's downloaded.

title.description: The title in every language the story is published in.

languages.description: Every language the story is published in, the story's first language first. A download brings them all.

bytes.description: The download in this language alone: the pictures, the text and the narration.

cover.description: The cover picture, shown on the shelf before the story is downloaded. Missing while it isn't delivered (dev only).

manifest.description: The story's current manifest (schema/manifest.schema.json). A new name means the story changed.
